result.summary: Design artefact for ISS-0660 (Type E inline) validated — all acceptance criteria covered. (1) AC-1 covered: both success test functions have their polymorphic PASS block replaced with a strict `try` call — `error.PublicSchemaPollution` is no longer accepted as PASS. (2) AC-2 covered: a hard pre-check query (`SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename NOT IN ('schema_migrations','migrations_lock')`) is specified to run BEFORE the production assertion; a `public.tenant_seed` table would cause `error.PublicSchemaPollutionPreCheck` (FAIL), not silent tolerance. (3) Both affected locations identified: `assertDatabaseConfiguration_success` (~lines 56–69) and `assertDatabaseConfiguration_with_overrides_success` (~lines 193–211) — cross-checked against source, confirmed match. (4) `tests/specs/ISS-0084.md` update fully specified: section 3.1 Expected Result replacement and section 6 two new AC items. (5) Design is unambiguous: SQL query, Zig replacement pattern, idiom notes, and allowlist rationale all provided. (6) No production source changes in scope — only `tests/integration/startup_assertions_test.zig` and `tests/specs/ISS-0084.md`. lint_handoffs.py exits 0.
